run_train_model: run the train_model function to train a BERT classifier on the MNLI dataset with mixed precision
create_MNLIDataset: create an MNLIDataset instance to load and tokenize MNLI premise-hypothesis pairs for a given split
review_MNLIDataset_getitem: review the MNLIDataset __getitem__ method that tokenizes text pairs and returns input IDs, attention masks, and labels
refactor_train_model: refactor the train_model function to adjust hyperparameters like learning rate, batch size, or number of epochs
summarize_MNLIDataset: summarize the MNLIDataset class that wraps the HuggingFace MNLI dataset with BERT tokenization
